k-conditioning.title: Can the mind ever be free of conditioning?
k-conditioning.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-conditioning.reference: 6th public talk, Saanen, 28 July 1970; inherited patterns, comparison, security, and reactive revolt. Official complete transcript.

k-known.title: Can the brain ever be free from the known?
k-known.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-known.reference: 6th public talk, Madras, 11 January 1981; freedom, memory, practical knowledge, and psychological dependence. Official complete transcript.

k-comparison.title: The movement of fear
k-comparison.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-comparison.reference: 3rd public talk, Bombay, 30 January 1982; opening discussion of practical and psychological comparison. Official complete transcript.

k-observer.title: Observing the content of consciousness
k-observer.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-observer.reference: 2nd public talk, Madras, 25 December 1977; closing discussion of controller/controlled, greed, anger, and observer/observed. Official complete transcript.

k-observer-foundation.title: The Observer and the Observed
k-observer-foundation.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-observer-foundation.reference: Foundation collection of primary excerpts; San Diego 1970, Talk 1 and Amsterdam 1967, Talk 1 on image, relationship, thought, and observer.

k-images.title: Relationships, images and hurt
k-images.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-images.reference: 1st public talk, Ojai, 3 April 1976; self-image, hurt, and relationship. Official complete transcript.

k-time.title: The movement of fear
k-time.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-time.reference: 3rd public talk, Bombay, 30 January 1982; chronological skill learning versus psychological becoming, and “what is”.

k-fear.title: Thought and time are the root of fear
k-fear.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-fear.reference: 1st public talk, Amsterdam, 19 September 1981; memory, anticipation, and thought-time as the proposed root of psychological fear. Official complete transcript.

k-place-thought.title: What is the place of thought?
k-place-thought.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-place-thought.reference: 2nd public talk, San Francisco, 11 March 1973; practical thought, remembered pleasure, anticipation, and fear. Official complete transcript.

k-desire.title: The movement of fear
k-desire.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-desire.reference: 3rd public talk, Bombay, 30 January 1982; seeing, contact, sensation, then thought’s image of oneself with clothes, furniture, or a car.

k-pleasure.title: Can the brain ever be free from the known?
k-pleasure.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-pleasure.reference: 6th public talk, Madras, 11 January 1981; discussion of enjoyment, memory, and thought giving pleasure continuity.

k-authority.title: Authority and freedom
k-authority.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-authority.reference: 2nd public talk, Paris, 7 September 1961; psychological versus outward practical authority, conformity, security, and direct inquiry.

k-core.title: The movement of fear
k-core.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-core.reference: 3rd public talk, Bombay, 30 January 1982; opening on shared inquiry, doubt and scepticism, speaker as a mirror to be put aside. Also distinguishes physical security.

k-choice.title: What it means to be totally aware
k-choice.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-choice.reference: 1st public discussion, Saanen, 27 July 1977; discussion of observing outwardly and inwardly without like/dislike or condemnation, “choiceless awareness”. Official complete transcript.

k-attention.title: In meditation there is no becoming nor being
k-attention.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-attention.reference: 6th public talk, Madras, 10 January 1982; meditation section distinguishing concentration, resistance, and a psychological centre from attention. Official complete transcript.

k-listen.title: The movement of fear
k-listen.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-listen.reference: 3rd public talk, Bombay, 30 January 1982; opening on the art of hearing, translating what others say, and conversation rather than accepting formulas.

k-word.title: Thought as a movement in time
k-word.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-word.reference: School discussion 7, Brockwood Park, 25 May 1975; words, tree, description, and the fact that a description is not its object.

k-security.title: The movement of fear
k-security.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-security.reference: 3rd public talk, Bombay, 30 January 1982; essential physical security versus psychological dependence on beliefs and images.

k-freedom.title: Freedom and conditioning
k-freedom.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-freedom.reference: 6th public talk, New Delhi, 25 February 1959; freedom from something as another condition or reaction, compared with freedom itself.

k-violence.title: The Observer and the Observed
k-violence.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-violence.reference: Primary excerpt “Observer and Observed”: violence as “what is”, non-violence as an ideal, division and psychological time.

k-loneliness.title: Is there such a thing as love?
k-loneliness.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-loneliness.reference: 1st public discussion, Brockwood Park, 30 August 1977; self-dialogue on attachment and loneliness, followed by thought’s isolating activity and the proposed ending of loneliness. Official complete transcript.

k-dependence.title: Relationship without dependence
k-dependence.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-dependence.reference: 3rd public discussion, Saanen, 3 August 1973; psychological versus practical dependence, possession, loneliness, and relationship. Official complete transcript.

k-love.title: Is there such a thing as love?
k-love.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-love.reference: 1st public discussion, Brockwood Park, 30 August 1977; self-dialogue on love, jealousy, attachment, motives, and psychological dependence. Official complete transcript.

k-limits.title: The limitation of thought
k-limits.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
k-limits.reference: 3rd public talk, Saanen, 13 July 1978; thought as registration, knowledge/memory, technological necessity, and limitations in human relationship. Official complete transcript.
